title: New CI demo-no-network grep lint fails on the tree it ships with — demo_api.gleam's api_error import trips the '^import api/' ban
evidence: VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "api_helpers\|^import api/" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)  — running the exact workflow commands against the worktree prints: LINT WOULD FAIL: client/src/demo/demo_api.gleam:18:import api/api_error.{type ApiError}
detail: The grep bans `^import api/` but demo_api.gleam imports the pure error type `api/api_error` (no network). The step exits 1 before lint_demo_network.py ever runs; the claimed green lint suite cannot pass as shipped.
recommended_fix: Exclude the pure type module in the grep, e.g. pipe through `grep -v "import api/api_error"` with a comment (mirroring the demo_api.gleam fetch exclusion), or move ApiError out of api/.

title: Cross-arm guard bleed reproduced in lint_demo_network.py — the claimed 'depth-aware arm boundaries' hardening did not land (r3 bite-test fails)
evidence:
window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window  — repro on a /tmp copy of the reviewed tree: injected unguarded `payment_api.checkout(model.csrf_token, "x", fn(r) { AppNoOp })` into the UserChangedSignupName arm (17 lines below the BrowserChangedUrl demo guard at client.gleam:487) → `python3 scripts/lint_demo_network.py` prints "demo no-network lint clean" and exits 0.
detail: The r3 bar requires the cross-arm bite-test to fail; the flat 35-line window still lets a guard in one arm satisfy an unguarded real api call in the arm below. A fix that didn't bite is a new blocker.
recommended_fix: Scope the guard window to the enclosing arm: stop the upward scan at the nearest message-arm or `fn` boundary (the walk already computes it) instead of a blanket 35 lines.

title: DEMO_INTERCEPTED manifest is still hand-synced — no mechanical cross-check against demo_update.handle exists in the script
evidence:
# demo_update.handle — a message listed here must have a demo arm there.
DEMO_INTERCEPTED = {  — `grep -n "demo_update" scripts/lint_demo_network.py` returns only comments and the error string (lines 41, 43, 170); no code reads demo/demo_update.gleam.
detail: The r3 fold list claims 'DEMO_INTERCEPTED verified against demo_update.handle'; the script contains no such check, so manifest drift (a message exempted but not intercepted) still passes silently.
recommended_fix: Parse demo_update.gleam's handled message set and fail the lint when DEMO_INTERCEPTED and the handled set disagree.

title: Zero-caller export shipped: demo_fixtures.result_to_seed_error (r2 #19 orphan fold residual)
evidence: pub fn result_to_seed_error(result: Result(a, String)) -> Result(a, SeedError) {  — `grep -rn "result_to_seed_error" client/ --include="*.gleam"` returns only this definition line; demo_store.gleam wires only seed_error_from_result (lines 151,155,159,163).
detail: Public helper with no call sites in src or test — the r2 orphan fold removed all_fixture_jsons/decode_checked but left this one.
